items.description: Dino of Seventeen will hold a concert in Macao on Oct. 10, his agency Pledis Entertainment announced Monday. It will be his first solo concert abroad and follows three concerts held in Seoul last week. The Macao gig is likely to be his last before he enlists on Oct. 26 and begins his mandatory military service as a member of the Army marching band along with Seungkwan. items.title: Hybe's new girl group Tuide debuts with EP 'Tune & Play'
items.snippet: Tuide, a new girl group from Hybe, the K-pop powerhouse behind global superstars BTS, made its debut Monday with its first EP, "Tune & Play." It is the first girl group presented b...
items.description: Tuide, a new girl group from Hybe, the K-pop powerhouse behind global superstars BTS, made its debut Monday with its first EP, "Tune & Play." It is the first girl group presented by ABD, a new label under Hybe, and the first from Hybe in two years following the U.S.-based group Katseye. Tuide consists of seven members -- Seohee, Seoyeon, Elena, Jia, Saki, Seah and Yi Hani. Seoyeon is a younger sister of JIhyo, a member of top-tier girl group TWICE.
